source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of source evaluation (PDF 185).

blocks.text: Source evaluation (source ki jaanch) ka matlab hai yeh check karna ke maloomat kahan se aa rahi hai.

Misal: Sarkari websites aur established (purane aur jaane maane) news organizations ko reliable (bharose ke qabil) samjha jata hai, kyunke woh apni maloomat sahi rakhne ke liye sakht guidelines (rules) par chalte hain. Pakistan mein official sarkari websites reliable sources ki misal hain.

blocks.prompt: Exam ki tareekhon ke liye kaunsa source zyada reliable hai: board ki official website ya WhatsApp par aage bheja gaya message?
blocks.explanation: Board ki official website, kyunke yeh asal aur zimmedar source hai; forward kiye gaye message ka asal source maloom nahi hota.

items: Source evaluation: maloomat kahan se aayi? Sarkari websites aur established news organizations reliable hain.
